templates.why_chosen: Overlays two named flow classes, black I/O Flow and blue Scheduling Flow, on the same Main Core/Worker Core boxes, with an inside top legend and circled steps 1-3 numbering only the control arrows.
templates.what_to_learn: Put the two-arrow-color legend and polling-icon key in one top-left inside block, then number only the control-flow arrows (steps 1-3) while leaving the data arrows unnumbered so the eye separates what happens always from what the scheduler decides.
